newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:
Spokesman Thierry Daman said the European Monetary Institute would hold a news conference in Frankfurt on April 15 at 1500/1400 GMT.

Spokeswoman Heike Gerstbrein said there would be a Cohesion Forum at the Palais des Congres from April 28 to 30. She said the Commission expected a broad debate on the achievements of the cohesion policy.

Spokesman Gerry Kiely said the EU and the U.S. had agreed to resume discussions on a veterinary equivalency agreement next Monday in Washington. He also said that the United States had announced that as from April 15, no European establishment would be able to export meat to the U.S. if it did not meet their inspection standards.
Following the signature of a Belarus/Russia agreement, spokesman Thierry Daman said that the EU/Russia agreement could not be transferred to a larger entity.
Daman also said all the EU ambassadors and the Commission would approach the Belarus Foreign Minister Ivan Antanovich concerning the deterioration of the situation in his country.
In answer to a question, spokesman Josep Coll i Carbo said all the Arab countries would participate in the Malta Conference on the EU/Mediterranean partnership to be held on April 15-16.

Coll i Carbo said that the EU could not reply to the Palestinian call for EU assistance if Israel did not agree to it. He also said the responsibility of the Middle East peace process was in the hands of the parties and the godparents, the United States and Russia. The EU cannot substitute for them, he said.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/265: Infringements in the social field.
- IP/97/266: European Cohesion Forum, 28 to 30 April 1997.
- IP/97/267: Commission declares RSB PSG/TENEX nuclear forwarding joint venture not to be a concentration under the EC Merger Regulation.
- IP/97/268: Commission approves joint-venture between Cereol and Oesat.
- Memo/97/36: Euro-Mediterranean Partnership: implementation of the multilateral aspects of the Barcelona Declaration.
- Memo/97/37: EU/US discussions on veterinary equivalence agreement.
